paper_metadata.title: Ultra-strong tungsten refractory high-entropy alloy via stepwise controllable coherent nanoprecipitations

evidence.quote: Here, we put forward a strategy to "defeat" this trade-off in tungsten refractory high-entropy alloys by stepwise controllable coherent nanoprecipitations (SCCPs).

Specifically, by departing from the traditional W-Fe-Ni compositions of tungsten heavy alloys, we design a (W1.5Ni2.25Fe)95Ta5 (at.%) refractory HEA with a stepwise and independently controllable dual coherent precipitation structure.
